WITH U AS( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY T.CAL_NM DESC) RNUM , T.*, D.DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT A.CAL_NM, A.CALENDAR_TY, A.CAL_TITLE, A.CAL_CONTENT, A.CAL_REG_DATE, A.CAL_CNT, A.CAL_STATUS, A.TEXT_COLOR, A.BG_COLOR, A.READER_NO, A.USER_NO,
(SELECT B.USER_NM FROM TB_USER B WHERE B.USER_NO = A.USER_NO) AS USER_NM, A.FILE_GROUP_NO, A.CAL_START, A.CAL_END ,F.FILE_SAVE_LOCATE FROM CALENDAR A LEFT OUTER JOIN FILE_GROUP G ON A.FILE_GROUP_NO = G.FILE_GROUP_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN FILE_DETAIL F ON G.FILE_GROUP_NO = F.FILE_GROUP_NO WHERE A.CALENDAR_TY = 2 ) T LEFT OUTER JOIN EMPLOYEE E on T.USER_NO = E.USER_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN DEPT D on E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO
WHERE CAL_STATUS = 1
) SELECT * FROM U WHERE U.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT A.CAL_NM, A.CALENDAR_TY, A.CAL_TITLE, A.CAL_CONTENT, A.CAL_REG_DATE, A.CAL_CNT, A.CAL_STATUS, A.TEXT_COLOR, A.BG_COLOR, A.READER_NO, A.USER_NO,
(SELECT B.USER_NM FROM TB_USER B WHERE B.USER_NO = A.USER_NO) AS USER_NM, A.FILE_GROUP_NO, A.CAL_START, A.CAL_END
FROM CALENDAR A
WHERE A.CALENDAR_TY = 2 )T, EMPLOYEE E, DEPT D WHERE T.USER_NO = E.USER_NO AND E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO AND CAL_STATUS = 1

SELECT B.CAL_NM, B.CAL_TITLE, B.CAL_CONTENT, B.CAL_START, B.CAL_END, B.USER_NO, B.CALENDAR_TY, B.FILE_GROUP_NO, B.CAL_STATUS, B.CAL_REG_DATE, B.READER_NO, B.CAL_CNT, (SELECT U.USER_NM FROM TB_USER U WHERE B.USER_NO = U.USER_NO) AS USER_NM, G.FILE_GROUP_NO, G.FILE_GROUP_NM, G.FILE_REGDATE, G.FILE_GROUP_TY, D.FILE_NO, D.FILE_GROUP_NO, D.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, D.FILE_SAVE_NAME, D.FILE_EXT, D.FILE_SIZE, D.FILE_SAVE_LOCATE, D.FILE_MIME, D.FILE_FANCYSIZE, D.FILE_SAVE_DATE, D.FILE_DOWNCOUNT FROM CALENDAR B JOIN TB_USER U ON B.USER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN FILE_GROUP G ON B.FILE_GROUP_NO = G.FILE_GROUP_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN FILE_DETAIL D ON G.FILE_GROUP_NO = D.FILE_GROUP_NO WHERE B.CAL_NM = #{calNm}

SELECT S.FILE_GROUP_NO, FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, FILE_SAVE_LOCATE FROM CALENDAR S , FILE_GROUP G , FILE_DETAIL D WHERE S.FILE_GROUP_NO = G.FILE_GROUP_NO AND G.FILE_GROUP_NO = D.FILE_GROUP_NO AND CAL_NM = #{calNm}
